description: Change Photoshop's preferences (Photoshop > Settings, or Edit > Preferences on Windows). Give only the settings to change; the result lists every preference afterwards. Some take effect after a restart

additionalPluginFolder.description: Absolute path of the Additional Plug-ins Folder; also turns it on (Preferences > Plugins)

appendExtension.description: Append File Extension: always, never or ask (Preferences > File handling)

askBeforeSavingLayeredTIFF.description: Ask before saving layered TIFF files (Preferences > File handling)

autoUpdateOpenDocuments.description: Auto-update open documents changed on disk (Preferences > General)

cacheForHistograms.description: Use the image cache for histograms (Preferences > Performance)

colorTheme.description: Interface colour theme, darkest to lightest (Preferences > Interface)

columnGutter.description: Column Size gutter, in points (Preferences > Units rulers)

columnWidth.description: Column Size width, in points (Preferences > Units rulers)

exportClipboard.description: Export Clipboard to other applications (Preferences > General)

fontNamesInEnglish.description: Show Font Names in English (Preferences > Type)

fontPreviewSize.description: Font Preview Size in font menus (none turns previews off) (Preferences > Type)

gamutWarningOpacity.description: Gamut Warning opacity, percent (Preferences > Transparency gamut)

gridStyle.description: Grid line style (Preferences > Guides grid slices)

guideStyle.description: Guide line style (Preferences > Guides grid slices)

historyStates.description: History States kept per document (Preferences > Performance)

imagePreviews.description: Image Previews: always save, never save or ask when saving (Preferences > File handling)

interpolation.description: Image Interpolation used when resampling (Preferences > General)

lowerCaseExtension.description: Use lower case file extensions (Preferences > File handling)

maxRAMuse.description: Memory Usage: percentage of available RAM Photoshop may use (Preferences > Performance)

maximizeCompatibility.description: Maximize PSD and PSB File Compatibility: always, never or ask (Preferences > File handling)

pointSize.description: Point/Pica Size: PostScript (72 points/inch) or traditional (72.27 points/inch) (Preferences > Units rulers)

recentFileListLength.description: Recent File List Contains, 0-100 files (Preferences > File handling)

rulerUnits.description: Rulers units (this server still measures in pixels) (Preferences > Units rulers)

scriptDialogs.description: Application.displayDialogs: whether other scripts and actions show dialogs (all, errors only or none). This server always runs its own scripts with dialogs off (Preferences > Scripting)

showSliceNumbers.description: Show Slice Numbers (Preferences > Guides grid slices)

transparencyGridSize.description: Transparency checkerboard Grid Size (Preferences > Transparency gamut)

typeUnits.description: Type units (this server still measures in pixels) (Preferences > Units rulers)

uiFontSize.description: UI Font Size (takes effect after a restart) (Preferences > Interface)

useAdditionalPluginFolder.description: Use the Additional Plug-ins Folder (takes effect after a restart) (Preferences > Plugins)

useShiftKeyForToolSwitch.description: Use Shift Key for Tool Switch (whether a tool shortcut needs Shift to cycle through grouped tools) (Preferences > General)

name: set_photoshop_preferences
title: Set Photoshop Preferences
